propositions: Unit-tier subprocess tests must enforce isolation by taking their root (cwd, HOME, env) from the harness-provided fixtures or explicitly via REBAR_ROOT environment variable, rather than defaulting to the operator's real checkout or home directory.

AST-based collection-time predicate must detect unsafe subprocess spawns in unit tests (calls to subprocess.run/Popen/check_output/check_call/call, os.system/os.popen, pytest.main) and fail with pytest.UsageError unless the subprocess takes its root from the harness or is explicitly exempted.
Tests with statically undecidable env=<bare variable> patterns must be reported as warnings, not failed, to avoid false positives on ~58 existing sites.
The @pytest.mark.allow_unharnessed_subprocess marker must require a non-blank reason string and fail collection if empty or missing, enforcing deliberate opt-in rather than silent blanket exclusion.

The ~26 identified hazard sites (env dict literals without REBAR_ROOT, cwd=REPO_ROOT patterns, operator HOME reads) must be fixed or explicitly marked before the guard is introduced, leaving the unit tier collection-clean.
